description: Tendon slack lengths (absolute, m) of the index extrinsic muscles, fitted per Binder-Markey & Murray 2017 (Eqs. 2-3: least squares on the extrinsic MCP moment of Knutson et al. 2000 over wrist -60..60 deg, plus (1/100) x sum of relative slack changes) with MuJoCo's passive force-length curve, MyoHand's muscle-tendon lengths and moment arms (scripts/fit_muscle_passive.py). reference_value_m is the slack length the fit started from (myo_sim with fix/anatomical-muscle-parameters, i.e. the MoBL-ARMS / Saul et al. 2015 values, also Binder-Markey's initial values). MyoHand's MCP has no hyperextension, so the fit covers MCP 0..90 deg (Knutson and Binder-Markey: -45..90 deg). Index finger only: no extrinsic passive data exist for the other digits. The model itself is myoarm_r_muscle.xml: scripts/fit_muscle_passive.py writes the shifted lengthrange of each muscle there (left arm mirrored).

binder_markey2017.citation: Binder-Markey BI, Murray WM. Incorporating the length-dependent passive-force generating muscle properties of the extrinsic finger muscles into a wrist and finger biomechanical musculoskeletal model. J Biomech 61:250-257, 2017.
binder_markey2017.access: closed; method (Eqs. 1-8) and Table 2 verified from the PDF

knutson2000.citation: Knutson JS, Kilgore KL, Mansour JM, Crago PE. Intrinsic and extrinsic contributions to the passive moment at the metacarpophalangeal joint. J Biomech 33(12):1675-1681, 2000.
knutson2000.access: closed; Eqs. (3)-(4) and Table 1 extrinsic medians verified from the PDF

binder_markey2017_table2.note: OpenSim compliant tendons; for comparison only (MyoHand tendons are rigid).
